verdict: key consistent: 72 signs for 73 letters as enciphered, 61/61 repeated occurrences one letter per shape; ي has a word-initial shape (Gl, in يرجى and ياوي) beside the usual one (Bk); انشب is written with three signs (ش or ن not written separately: the π-with-hook sign may stand for نش); the cipher has بان for the record's ان.
notes: Text as enciphered: قصدتك حين ضاق الامر لما رايت الدهر انشب مخلبيه / علمت بان غيرك ليس يرجى وانك كهف من ياوي اليه. The second hemistich's ان is enciphered بان (the group runs ب ا | ن across the line end, I X / Dl, with the same ب, ا and ن signs as elsewhere).

انشب: X, Pi2, I. ن is elsewhere Dl (four times) and Pi2 carries a ے-like curl over a π: the alignment puts Pi2 on ن and records ش as dropped; it may be one sign for نش, or ش with ن dropped. Not forced.

Counts by eye: 8, 11, 13, 11, 12, 10, 7 = 72 (record by eye 75; the segmenter's 81 included the heading ومن ذلك). 19 groups = 19 words. Against the record's wording: 72 signs vs 72 letters with one surplus/dropped pair at بان.
The ي shapes look positional: Gl begins words (يرجى, ياوي), Bk stands inside and at the end (حين, رايت, مخلبيه, غيرك, ليس, يرجى, ياوي, اليه).
